page.overview:
Who is Dairuin?

Dairuin was one of the XII Bëorings who followed Barahir in the First Age.

Dairuin fought in the Dagor Bragollach under his captain Barahir. With the loss of the battle, he remained with a small band of men resisting Morgoth and thus became an outlaw. He was killed along with the other outlaws in FA 460, save for Beren.
